record.context_brief: non-negative curvature on vector-bundle total spaces
record.original_question: Given a compact simply connected manifold M with non-negative sectional curvature and a vector bundle V → M, does the total space of V admit a metric of non-negative sectional curvature?

evidence.quote: Question 4.9. Given a compact, simply-connected manifold M with non-negative sectional curvature and a vector bundle V→ M, does there exist a metric of non-negative sectional curvature on the total space?

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let $M$ be a compact, simply connected smooth manifold equipped with a Riemannian metric of non-negative sectional curvature, and let $\pi : V \to M$ be a smooth real vector bundle over $M$. Does the total space $V$ admit a complete Riemannian metric of non-negative sectional curvature?
artifact.category_tag: non-negative sectional curvature on vector bundles
artifact.status_search_result: The question is widely listed as an open problem in non-negative sectional curvature. Partial results are known: every vector bundle over a compact rank-one symmetric space admits non-negative sectional curvature after Whitney-summing with a trivial bundle of sufficiently high rank, and all vector bundles over $S^4$ (and non-spin bundles over $\mathbb{CP}^2$) carry such metrics. The general question for arbitrary simply connected non-negatively curved bases remains open.

status_evidence.title: Open Problems in Non-negative Sectional Curvature (compiled by M. Kerin)
status_evidence.snippet: Lists the question of whether vector bundles over compact simply-connected non-negatively curved manifolds admit non-negative sectional curvature on their total spaces (possibly after stabilization) as open.
status_evidence.claim: Problem appears in standard open-problem lists for non-negative sectional curvature.

status_evidence.title: Nonnegative curvature on stable bundles over compact rank one symmetric spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Every vector bundle over a CROSS admits non-negative sectional curvature after Whitney sum with a trivial bundle of sufficiently large rank.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results are known in the stable / CROSS case.
